ATO-01.name: New phone, new payee, then transfer
ATO-01.description: Within 30 minutes: a new device is linked, a new payee is added, and money is sent above the institution's minimum
ATO-01.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-01 | weight=30 | action=signal
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(device.bound  WHERE device.is_new = true)
AND   EXISTS(beneficiary.added WHERE beneficiary.is_new = true)
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=ATO-01  evidence=(device.id, beneficiary.id, times)

ATO-02.name: Details changed before a transfer
ATO-02.description: Password, phone number or email changed in the last 24 hours, then money sent above the minimum
ATO-02.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-02 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    ANY OF ( EXISTS(profile.password_changed OVER 24h) ,
               EXISTS(profile.phone_changed    OVER 24h) ,
               EXISTS(profile.email_changed    OVER 24h) )
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=ATO-02  evidence=(change_type, change_time)

ATO-03.name: Possible SIM swap
ATO-03.description: The telco reports a SIM swap, or the SIM or device was re-registered in the last 72 hours, then money is sent
ATO-03.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-03 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    ANY OF ( telco.sim_swap_flag = true , EXISTS(sim.reregistered OVER 72h) , EXISTS(device.reregistered OVER 72h) )
THEN  signal=ATO-03  evidence=(swap_source, swap_time)

ATO-04.name: Tampered phone
ATO-04.description: The phone is rooted, jailbroken, an emulator, or running tools that interfere with the app
ATO-04.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-04 | weight=20
WHEN  session.login OR txn.created
IF    ANY OF ( device.rooted = true , device.jailbroken = true , device.emulator = true , device.hooking_framework = true )
THEN  signal=ATO-04  evidence=(integrity_flags)

ATO-05.name: Odd session
ATO-05.description: The same account is open in several places at once, or the location, browser or device changes mid-session
ATO-05.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-05 | weight=20
WHEN  session.activity
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(DISTINCT session.id WHERE open = true) > 1 ,
               session.ip != session.start_ip ,
               session.user_agent != session.start_user_agent ,
               session.device_fp != session.start_device_fp )
THEN  signal=ATO-05  evidence=(changed_attributes)

ATO-06.name: PIN or OTP guessing
ATO-06.description: Three or more wrong PINs or one-time codes in 10 minutes, then a correct one
ATO-06.engineering_logic:
RULE ATO-06 | weight=15
WHEN  auth.success
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(auth.failure WHERE type IN (otp, pin)) >= 3
THEN  signal=ATO-06

BEH-01.name: Unusual amount
BEH-01.description: The amount is far above the customer's own history (more than 3 standard deviations above their 90-day average, or 5 times their largest), for customers with at least 30 days of history
BEH-01.engineering_logic:
RULE BEH-01 | weight=24
WHEN  txn.created
IF    ANY OF ( txn.amount > AVG(txn.amount OVER 90d) + 3 * STDDEV(txn.amount OVER 90d) ,
               txn.amount > 5 * MAX(txn.amount OVER 90d) )
AND   customer.history_days >= 30                            # cold-start exclusion
THEN  signal=BEH-01

BEH-02.name: Unusual location
BEH-02.description: A country or region the customer does not normally use (10 points), or two events too far apart to travel between in the time (20 points)
BEH-02.engineering_logic:
RULE BEH-02 | weight=10 or 20
WHEN  session.login OR txn.created
IF    geo.country NOT IN profile.usual_countries THEN signal=BEH-02 weight=10
IF    distance(geo, previous.geo) / time_between > 900 km/h THEN signal=BEH-02 weight=20   # impossible travel

BEH-03.name: Unusual time
BEH-03.description: Activity outside the customer's usual hours
BEH-03.engineering_logic:
RULE BEH-03 | weight=8
WHEN  txn.created
IF    local_hour(txn.ts) NOT IN profile.usual_hours  AND  profile.history_days >= 30
THEN  signal=BEH-03

CNP-01.name: Card testing
CNP-01.description: Ten or more tiny (under ₦500) or declined attempts on one card, network address or device in 5 minutes
CNP-01.engineering_logic:
RULE CNP-01 | weight=25
WHEN  card.authorization
WINDOW 5m BY card.id OR ip OR device.id
IF    COUNT(auth WHERE amount < NGN 500 OR result = declined) >= 10
THEN  signal=CNP-01

CNP-02.name: Many cards, one device
CNP-02.description: Five or more different cards used from one device or network address in an hour
CNP-02.engineering_logic:
RULE CNP-02 | weight=25
WHEN  card.authorization
WINDOW 1h BY device.id OR ip
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT card.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=CNP-02

CNP-03.name: Suspicious merchant
CNP-03.description: A merchant's refunds or chargebacks run at more than three times its own normal rate, or its terminal is active from impossible locations
CNP-03.engineering_logic:
RULE CNP-03 | weight=20
WHEN  merchant.daily_job OR terminal.activity
IF    merchant.refund_rate  > 3 * merchant.refund_rate_baseline
   OR merchant.chargeback_rate > 3 * merchant.chargeback_rate_baseline
   OR terminal.impossible_location = true
THEN  signal=CNP-03  scope=merchant

CRY-01.name: Cash to crypto to outside wallet
CRY-01.description: Money comes in, is used to buy crypto, and 80% or more is sent to an outside wallet within 24 hours
CRY-01.engineering_logic:
RULE CRY-01 | weight=25
WHEN  crypto.withdrawal
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(fiat.inflow) AND EXISTS(crypto.purchase)
AND   SUM(crypto.withdrawal.external) >= 0.80 * SUM(crypto.purchase)
THEN  signal=CRY-01

CRY-02.name: Many funders, quick exit
CRY-02.description: Five or more different cards or accounts fund one account in 7 days, then 80% or more leaves within 24 hours
CRY-02.engineering_logic:
RULE CRY-02 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT funding_source.id OVER 7d BY account.id) >= 5
AND   SUM(outflow OVER 24h) >= 0.80 * SUM(inflow OVER 24h)
THEN  signal=CRY-02

CRY-03.name: Risky destination wallet
CRY-03.description: Blockchain analysis flags the receiving wallet as sanctioned, a mixer, darknet or an unlicensed provider
CRY-03.engineering_logic:
RULE CRY-03 | weight=35
WHEN  crypto.withdrawal
IF    analytics.wallet_tag IN (sanctioned, mixer, darknet, unlicensed_provider)
THEN  signal=CRY-03  action_hint=hold_and_review

CRY-04.name: Large crypto transfer
CRY-04.description: A transfer above the institution's chosen limit (the official SEC limit is still awaited)
CRY-04.engineering_logic:
RULE CRY-04 | weight=15
WHEN  crypto.transfer
IF    txn.amount > tenant.cfg.va_threshold      # official SEC threshold awaited
THEN  signal=CRY-04

GOV-01.name: Monitoring tied to customer checks
GOV-01.description: Monitoring must use KYC and KYB data; a system without that link is not compliant, and the readiness check fails
GOV-01.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-01 | type=policy
IF    tenant.monitoring.enabled = true AND tenant.kyc_data.linked = false
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=monitoring_without_cdd_linkage

GOV-02.name: Network and peer analysis
GOV-02.description: Daily review of how customers are linked, and comparison against similar customers
GOV-02.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-02 | type=job | schedule=daily
THEN  build(related_party_graph)  AND  compare(customer, peer_group)  emit=network_signals

GOV-03.name: Careful alert closing
GOV-03.description: Alerts close automatically only when low risk, on an approved list of rules, with tuning decisions documented. Everything else stays open for a person
GOV-03.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-03 | type=policy
WHEN  alert.auto_close_requested
IF    alert.risk_level = LOW AND rule.in(tenant.cfg.auto_close_allowlist) AND tuning.documented = true
THEN  allow_auto_close  ELSE keep_open

GOV-04.name: Annual model check
GOV-04.description: AI and statistical models are independently validated at least every 12 months for accuracy, bias, drift and explainability
GOV-04.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-04 | type=job | schedule=annual
IF    model.last_validated > 12mo
THEN  readiness=fail  require=independent_validation(accuracy, bias, drift, explainability)

GOV-05.name: Continuous screening
GOV-05.description: Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media checks at onboarding and continuously after, covering customers, owners and counterparties
GOV-05.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-05 | type=control
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR list.updated OR daily_job
THEN  run REG-11  AND  REG-12  AND  adverse_media_screen  FOR customer, beneficial_owner, counterparty

GOV-06.name: Approved reporting
GOV-06.description: STRs, SARs, CTRs and FTRs are prepared automatically, but a compliance officer must approve before submission
GOV-06.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-06 | type=workflow
WHEN  report.draft_ready  (STR, SAR, CTR, FTR)
IF    report.approved_by IN roles(compliance_officer)
THEN  allow_submit  ELSE hold_for_approval

GOV-07.name: Audit trail and access control
GOV-07.description: Every action is logged tamper-proof; access is role-based with extra verification, and data is encrypted
GOV-07.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-07 | type=control
WHEN  any.state_change
THEN  append(audit_log, hash_chain)  AND  enforce(rbac, mfa)  AND  encrypt(at_rest, in_transit)

GOV-08.name: Record keeping
GOV-08.description: Records cannot be deleted before five years after the transaction or end of the relationship
GOV-08.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-08 | type=control
WHEN  record.delete_requested
IF    record.age < 5y_after(txn OR relationship_end)
THEN  deny_delete  reason=retention

GOV-09.name: No tipping off
GOV-09.description: Nothing about an STR or suspicion flag appears in customer-facing screens, responses, alerts to outside systems or exports; only compliance roles see it
GOV-09.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-09 | type=control
WHEN  api.response OR webhook.send OR export.generate
IF    payload CONTAINS (str.exists OR str.status OR flag.visibility = compliance_only)
AND   recipient.role NOT IN (compliance_officer, mlro)
THEN  strip_fields  AND  log=audit

GOV-10.name: Digital lender registration
GOV-10.description: A digital lender cannot be activated without its FCCPC approval (banks and other CBN-supervised firms are exempt)
GOV-10.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-10 | type=policy
WHEN  tenant.activate
IF    tenant.type = digital_lender AND tenant.fccpc_approval IS NULL AND tenant.regulator != CBN
THEN  deny_activate  reason=missing_fccpc_registration

GOV-11.name: Fast fraud response
GOV-11.description: A confirmed-fraud alert not actioned within 30 minutes is escalated
GOV-11.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-11 | type=sla
WHEN  alert.fraud_confirmed
IF    NOW - alert.confirmed_at > 30m AND alert.actioned = false
THEN  escalate  reason=fraud_response_target

GOV-12.name: Fraud reporting
GOV-12.description: Confirmed fraud can be reported to the industry channel in one click, and unreported confirmed cases are tracked
GOV-12.engineering_logic:
RULE GOV-12 | type=workflow
WHEN  alert.fraud_confirmed
THEN  offer(report_to_industry_channel)  AND  track(unreported_confirmed_cases)

INS-01.name: Staff-linked account
INS-01.description: An account tied to an employee moves far more than similar accounts, or deals with customers that employee serves. Visible to compliance staff only
INS-01.engineering_logic:
RULE INS-01 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE account.linked_to_employee = true
IF    SUM(txn.amount OVER 30d) > peer_group.p95(SUM OVER 30d)
   OR EXISTS(txn WHERE counterparty.customer_id IN employee.serviced_customers)
THEN  signal=INS-01  visibility=compliance_only   # gov=GOV-09

INS-02.name: Staff access, then takeover
INS-02.description: Staff viewed or changed a customer's contact details or limits, then money leaves that customer's account within 24 hours
INS-02.engineering_logic:
RULE INS-02 | weight=30
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 24h BY customer.id
IF    EXISTS(staff_action WHERE type IN (view_contact, change_contact, change_limits))
THEN  signal=INS-02  evidence=(staff.id, action, time)

LEN-01.name: Loan stacking
LEN-01.description: Three or more loan applications from one BVN or device in 7 days
LEN-01.engineering_logic:
RULE LEN-01 | weight=20
WHEN  loan.application.submitted
WINDOW 7d BY bvn OR device.id
IF    COUNT(application) >= 3
THEN  signal=LEN-01

LEN-02.name: Borrow and cash out
LEN-02.description: 90% or more of a loan is moved out within 30 minutes of payout
LEN-02.engineering_logic:
RULE LEN-02 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(loan.disbursement)
AND   SUM(txn.amount) >= 0.90 * loan.disbursement.amount
THEN  signal=LEN-02

LEN-03.name: Reused identity
LEN-03.description: The same photo, ID document or phone number appears on different applicants
LEN-03.engineering_logic:
RULE LEN-03 | weight=25
WHEN  loan.application.submitted
IF    ANY OF ( photo_hash IN other_applicants , id_document_hash IN other_applicants , phone IN other_applicants )
THEN  signal=LEN-03

LEN-04.name: Repayments from strangers
LEN-04.description: Three or more repayments in 30 days from accounts whose BVN differs from the borrower's
LEN-04.engineering_logic:
RULE LEN-04 | weight=15
WHEN  loan.repayment
WINDOW 30d BY loan.id
IF    COUNT(repayment WHERE payer.bvn != borrower.bvn) >= 3
THEN  signal=LEN-04

MUL-01.name: Money passing straight through
MUL-01.description: 80% or more of money received leaves within 60 minutes
MUL-01.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-01 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 60m BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=out) >= 0.80 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in) > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=MUL-01  evidence=(in_sum, out_sum, ratio)

MUL-02.name: Many senders into one account
MUL-02.description: Ten or more different senders pay one account in 24 hours
MUL-02.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-02 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id) >= 10
THEN  signal=MUL-02

MUL-03.name: One payment split many ways
MUL-03.description: One incoming payment is split among five or more recipients within 60 minutes
MUL-03.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-03 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 60m BY source_inflow.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=MUL-03

MUL-04.name: New account, big volume
MUL-04.description: An account under 7 days old moves more than ten times what is normal for its KYC tier
MUL-04.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-04 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE account.age < 7d
IF    SUM(txn.amount OVER account.age) > 10 * kyc_tier.norm(account.kyc_tier)
THEN  signal=MUL-04  evidence=(volume, tier_norm)

MUL-05.name: Dormant account wakes up
MUL-05.description: No activity for 90 days or more, then a large payment in or out
MUL-05.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-05 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
IF    account.days_since_last_activity >= 90
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.large_after_dormancy
THEN  signal=MUL-05

MUL-06.name: Shared identity details
MUL-06.description: One device used on three or more accounts, or one BVN, phone number or address on several accounts or applications
MUL-06.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-06 | weight=25
WHEN  account.created OR application.submitted OR txn.created
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY device.id)  >= 3 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY bvn)        >= 2 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY phone)      >= 2 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY address)    >= 2 )
THEN  signal=MUL-06  evidence=(shared_identifier, linked_accounts)

MUL-07.name: Reported recipient
MUL-07.description: The recipient was reported by three or more unrelated senders, or is on a fraud list or the Person of Interest list
MUL-07.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-07 | weight=30
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(DISTINCT reporter.id WHERE report.beneficiary = txn.beneficiary) >= 3 ,
               beneficiary IN fraud_list , beneficiary IN nibss.person_of_interest )
THEN  signal=MUL-07

MUL-08.name: Quick cash-out
MUL-08.description: Money arrives by card or peer-to-peer and is withdrawn at an ATM or POS within 30 minutes
MUL-08.engineering_logic:
RULE MUL-08 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type IN (atm.withdrawal, pos.purchase)
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(inflow WHERE source IN (card, p2p))
AND   txn.amount >= 0.70 * inflow.amount
THEN  signal=MUL-08

PON-01.name: Ponzi-style pooling
PON-01.description: Twenty or more unrelated senders pay one account in 7 days, and 30% or more of what it pays out goes to people who paid in earlier
PON-01.engineering_logic:
RULE PON-01 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id WHERE unrelated = true) >= 20
AND   SUM(outflow WHERE recipient IN prior_senders) >= 0.30 * SUM(outflow)
THEN  signal=PON-01

REG-01.name: New-device limit
REG-01.description: A customer sends more than ₦20,000 within 24 hours of linking a new phone or app, or within 24 hours of opening the account
REG-01.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-01 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
SCOPE tenant.type IN (bank, mfb, psp) AND tenant.instant_payments = true
IF    txn.amount > tenant.cfg.new_device_cap            # default NGN 20_000
AND   ANY OF ( device.bound_age < 24h , account.age < 24h )
THEN  decision=decline  reason=new_device_or_account_cap

REG-02.name: One active device
REG-02.description: A customer logs in on a second phone while another is already linked to the mobile banking app
REG-02.action: Blocks the second login until the customer re-verifies on the new phone
REG-02.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-02 | control=hard | action=block_session
WHEN  session.login
SCOPE channel = mobile_app
IF    device.id != account.active_device_id
AND   account.active_device_id IS NOT NULL
THEN  decision=block_session  require=fresh_auth_on_new_device  reason=single_active_device

REG-03.name: New-device web login
REG-03.description: A customer logs in to internet banking from a device not seen before
REG-03.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-03 | control=hard | action=step_up
WHEN  session.login
SCOPE channel = web
IF    device.is_new = true
THEN  decision=step_up  require=enhanced_mfa  reason=new_device_web_login

REG-04.name: Very large transfers
REG-04.description: An individual sends more than ₦25m, or a company more than ₦250m, unless the limit was raised after enhanced checks and extra verification
REG-04.action: Blocks the transfer or sends it for enhanced checks
REG-04.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-04 | control=hard | action=block_or_edd
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    ( customer.type = individual AND txn.amount > NGN 25_000_000 )
   OR ( customer.type = corporate  AND txn.amount > NGN 250_000_000 )
UNLESS account.limit_raised = true AND account.limit_raise.edd_done = true AND account.limit_raise.mfa_done = true
THEN  decision=block  route=edd_queue  reason=high_value_ceiling

REG-05.name: Suspect BVN hold
REG-05.description: The sender's BVN is on a temporary suspicious list
REG-05.action: Holds the transfer for up to 24 hours while it is investigated, and opens a case
REG-05.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-05 | control=hard | action=hold
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    customer.bvn IN watchlist.temporary_suspect_bvn
THEN  decision=hold  hold_max=24h  case=open  reason=suspect_bvn_hold

REG-06.name: Digital account opening
REG-06.description: An account is opened or reactivated online without a live-face check, or without live confirmation of the BVN or NIN
REG-06.action: Blocks the account opening or reactivation
REG-06.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-06 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  account.open OR account.reactivate
SCOPE channel = digital
IF    kyc.liveness_passed = false
   OR kyc.bvn_live_check != verified
   OR kyc.nin_live_check != verified
THEN  decision=block  reason=digital_onboarding_identity_incomplete

REG-07.name: Cash payment ceiling
REG-07.action: Flags it; payments above the ceiling must go through a financial institution
REG-07.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-07 | control=hard | action=flag
WHEN  txn.type = cash.payment
IF    ( customer.type = individual AND txn.amount > NGN 5_000_000 )
   OR ( customer.type = corporate  AND txn.amount > NGN 10_000_000 )
THEN  flag=cash_ceiling  require=route_via_financial_institution

REG-08.name: Weekly cash withdrawals
REG-08.description: Cash withdrawals across all channels exceed ₦1.5m (individual) or ₦5m (company) in a week
REG-08.action: Applies the 3% (individual) or 5% (company) charge to the excess. Banks only; each institution switches it on or off
REG-08.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-08 | control=hard | action=fee | toggle=tenant.type=bank
WHEN  txn.type = cash.withdrawal
SCOPE tenant.type = bank AND tenant.cfg.cash_fee_enabled = true
WINDOW 7d (calendar week)  BY customer.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE channel=any) > ( individual ? NGN 1_500_000 : NGN 5_000_000 )
THEN  fee = ( individual ? 3% : 5% ) * excess  reason=weekly_cash_limit

REG-09.name: ATM limits
REG-09.description: ATM withdrawals above ₦100,000 in a day or ₦850,000 in a week for one customer
REG-09.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-09 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type = atm.withdrawal
IF    SUM(txn.amount) OVER 1d  BY customer.id > NGN 100_000
   OR SUM(txn.amount) OVER 7d  BY customer.id > NGN 850_000
THEN  decision=decline  reason=atm_limit

REG-10.name: Foreign transfers
REG-10.description: An international transfer of US$10,000 or more (or equivalent)
REG-10.action: Prepares a report to the NFIU, due within one day of the transaction
REG-10.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-10 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.international
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv >= 10_000
THEN  task=report.FTR  due=1d_after_txn  to=NFIU

REG-11.name: Sanctions match
REG-11.description: A name, ID or account matches the Nigerian sanctions list, UN lists or other chosen lists (including spelling variations and transliterations), and the match is confirmed or is strong enough for automatic action
REG-11.action: Blocks and freezes, opens a case, and prepares reports to the NFIU and the Nigeria Sanctions Committee
REG-11.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-11 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  txn.created OR customer.onboarded OR list.updated
IF    screen(party.name, party.id, party.account) MATCHES sanctions_lists
        USING fuzzy + transliteration  score >= tenant.cfg.match_threshold
AND   match.reviewed = confirmed OR tenant.cfg.auto_block_on_strong_match = true
THEN  decision=block  freeze=account  case=open  task=report.NFIU,NigSaC  reason=sanctions_match

REG-12.name: Politically exposed person
REG-12.description: The customer, or an owner behind a company, is a PEP
REG-12.action: Sends for review with enhanced checks: source of funds, source of wealth and senior management approval
REG-12.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-12 | control=hard | action=edd
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR customer.periodic_review OR txn.created
IF    customer.is_pep = true OR ANY(beneficial_owner.is_pep = true)
THEN  decision=review  require=edd,source_of_funds,source_of_wealth,senior_approval  reason=pep

REG-13.name: Person of interest
REG-13.description: The customer or the other party appears on the NIBSS Person of Interest list
REG-13.action: Sends for review and opens a case
REG-13.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-13 | control=hard | action=review
WHEN  txn.created OR customer.onboarded
IF    customer.id OR counterparty.id IN nibss.person_of_interest
THEN  decision=review  case=open  reason=person_of_interest

REG-14.name: Suspicious transaction report (STR)
REG-14.description: An alert is still open after 72 hours; or an analyst confirms suspicion
REG-14.action: Escalates the old alert to the compliance officer; once suspicion is confirmed, starts a 24-hour clock to file with the NFIU
REG-14.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-14 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  alert.created
IF    alert.age > 72h AND alert.status = open
THEN  escalate=compliance_officer  reason=screening_sla_breach
WHEN  alert.suspicion_confirmed
THEN  task=report.STR  due=24h  to=NFIU  gov=GOV-09

REG-15.name: BVN watchlist
REG-15.description: The customer's BVN is on the CBN watchlist (categories 0, 1, 2 or 99) and the listing is still active (5 years for category 0, 10 years for the others)
REG-15.action: Blocks new relationships, ATM, POS, internet and mobile banking, cheques and credit
REG-15.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-15 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR txn.created OR credit.requested OR session.login
IF    customer.bvn.watchlist_category IN (0, 1, 2, 99)
AND   watchlist.entry.active = true       # category 0 lasts 5y, others 10y
THEN  decision=block  scope=(new_relationship, atm, pos, web, mobile, cheque, credit)  reason=bvn_watchlist

REG-16.name: Accounts without BVN
REG-16.description: An account or wallet has no BVN
REG-16.action: Allows money in only; closes the account after 30 days
REG-16.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-16 | control=hard | action=restrict
WHEN  account.created OR daily_job
IF    account.bvn IS NULL
THEN  restrict=inflow_only
AND   IF account.age >= 30d THEN task=close_account

REG-17.name: Large cash report
REG-17.description: A domestic cash deposit, withdrawal or payment of ₦5m or more (individual) or ₦10m or more (company)
REG-17.action: Prepares a currency transaction report for the NFIU (domestic cash only)
REG-17.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-17 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, cash.withdrawal, cash.payment)
SCOPE txn.domestic = true
IF    ( customer.type = individual AND txn.amount >= NGN 5_000_000 )
   OR ( customer.type = corporate  AND txn.amount >= NGN 10_000_000 )
THEN  task=report.CTR  format=goAML

REG-18.name: PEP monthly report
REG-18.description: Any transaction by a PEP, of any size
REG-18.action: Adds it to the monthly PEP transaction report
REG-18.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-18 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.created
IF    customer.is_pep = true
THEN  add_to=monthly_pep_report  amount_floor=none

REG-19.name: STR completeness
REG-19.description: An STR is submitted without an offence category, a matching indicator, or one of the allowed report types
REG-19.action: Stops the submission so the NFIU system does not reject it
REG-19.engineering_logic:
RULE REG-19 | control=hard | action=validate
WHEN  report.STR.submit
IF    report.predicate_offence IS NULL
   OR report.indicator IS NULL
   OR report.category NOT IN (terrorism_financing, kidnapping_ransom, corruption, fraud, drug_trafficking, general)
THEN  reject_submit  reason=goaml_would_reject

SEC-01.name: Stolen-password testing
SEC-01.description: Ten or more failed logins from one network address across five or more accounts in 5 minutes
SEC-01.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-01 | weight=30
WHEN  auth.failure
WINDOW 5m BY ip
IF    COUNT(auth.failure) >= 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT account.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=SEC-01  action_hint=rate_limit_ip

SEC-02.name: Password spraying
SEC-02.description: One failed login each on 50 or more accounts from one network in an hour
SEC-02.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-02 | weight=25
WHEN  auth.failure
WINDOW 1h BY network(asn OR /24)
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT account.id WHERE failures_per_account = 1) >= 50
THEN  signal=SEC-02

SEC-03.name: Repeated guessing
SEC-03.description: Five or more failed logins on one account in 10 minutes
SEC-03.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-03 | weight=20
WHEN  auth.failure
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(auth.failure) >= 5
THEN  signal=SEC-03  action_hint=temporary_lock

SEC-04.name: Approval-prompt flooding
SEC-04.description: Five or more push or OTP prompts to one user in 10 minutes
SEC-04.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-04 | weight=25
WHEN  mfa.prompt_sent
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(mfa.prompt_sent WHERE type IN (push, otp)) >= 5
THEN  signal=SEC-04  action_hint=pause_prompts

SEC-05.name: Hidden location
SEC-05.description: An admin or high-value session uses Tor, a known proxy or a VPN
SEC-05.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-05 | weight=10
WHEN  session.login OR txn.created
SCOPE ( user.role = admin OR txn.amount > tenant.cfg.high_value )
IF    ip.is_tor = true OR ip.is_known_proxy = true OR ip.is_vpn = true
THEN  signal=SEC-05

SEC-06.name: Automated behaviour
SEC-06.description: A hidden browser, or typing and timing that is not human
SEC-06.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-06 | weight=20
WHEN  session.activity
IF    ANY OF ( client.headless = true , input.keystroke_interval_ms < tenant.cfg.min_human , input.timing_variance < tenant.cfg.min_variance )
THEN  signal=SEC-06

SEC-07.name: Session takeover
SEC-07.description: The location changes mid-session together with a change of browser or device
SEC-07.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-07 | weight=25
WHEN  session.activity
IF    session.ip != session.start_ip
AND   ANY OF ( session.user_agent != start_user_agent , session.device_fp != start_device_fp )
THEN  signal=SEC-07  action_hint=revoke_session

SEC-08.name: API key misuse
SEC-08.description: A key is used from a new network or country, at five times its normal rate, or with many failed or not-found requests that suggest guessing IDs
SEC-08.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-08 | weight=30
WHEN  api.request
SCOPE auth.type = api_key
IF    ANY OF ( request.network NOT IN key.known_networks ,
               request.country NOT IN key.known_countries ,
               RATE(request OVER 5m) > 5 * key.baseline_rate ,
               RATIO(status IN (400, 404) OVER 10m) > tenant.cfg.probe_ratio )
THEN  signal=SEC-08  action_hint=throttle_key

SEC-09.name: Payout details changed
SEC-09.description: A webhook address, payout destination or bank account is changed, then a high-value transaction follows within 24 hours
SEC-09.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-09 | weight=30
WHEN  txn.created
WINDOW 24h BY tenant.id OR merchant.id
IF    EXISTS(config.changed WHERE field IN (webhook_url, payout_destination, bank_account))
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.high_value
THEN  signal=SEC-09  action_hint=hold_payout

SEC-10.name: Rights raised, then data exported
SEC-10.description: A user's role is upgraded and they export data within the hour
SEC-10.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-10 | weight=30
WHEN  data.export
WINDOW 1h BY user.id
IF    EXISTS(user.role_changed)
THEN  signal=SEC-10

SEC-11.name: Probing for valid accounts
SEC-11.description: Twenty or more lookups of accounts or IDs that do not exist, from one source in 10 minutes
SEC-11.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-11 | weight=20
WHEN  api.lookup
WINDOW 10m BY source(ip OR api_key)
IF    COUNT(lookup WHERE result = not_found) >= 20
THEN  signal=SEC-11

SEC-12.name: Unusually large export
SEC-12.description: An export far above the user's or institution's normal size
SEC-12.engineering_logic:
RULE SEC-12 | weight=25
WHEN  data.export
IF    export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY user.id OVER 30d)
   OR export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY tenant.id OVER 30d)
THEN  signal=SEC-12

SIM-01.name: Phone not linked to NIN
SIM-01.description: The phone number is not linked to a verified NIN, and money is sent above the minimum
SIM-01.engineering_logic:
RULE SIM-01 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    identity.phone_nin_linked = false
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=SIM-01

SIM-02.name: Frequent phone changes
SIM-02.description: The phone number on the profile changed twice or more in 30 days
SIM-02.engineering_logic:
RULE SIM-02 | weight=15
WHEN  profile.phone_changed
WINDOW 30d BY customer.id
IF    COUNT(profile.phone_changed) >= 2
THEN  signal=SIM-02

SIM-03.name: Recycled number
SIM-03.description: The phone number now belongs to a different person than the one on the profile
SIM-03.engineering_logic:
RULE SIM-03 | weight=25
WHEN  telco.lookup OR txn.created
IF    telco.msisdn_subscriber_id != profile.phone_subscriber_id
THEN  signal=SIM-03

VEL-01.name: Burst of transfers
VEL-01.description: Five or more transfers out in 10 minutes
VEL-01.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-01 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(txn) >= 5
THEN  signal=VEL-01  evidence=(count, window)

VEL-02.name: Sudden spike
VEL-02.description: Money sent out in 24 hours is more than three times the customer's usual daily amount, and above the institution's minimum
VEL-02.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-02 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount) > 3 * AVG(daily_outbound OVER 30d)     # relative condition
AND   SUM(txn.amount) > tenant.cfg.floor                     # absolute condition
THEN  signal=VEL-02  evidence=(sum_24h, avg_30d)

VEL-03.name: Many new payees
VEL-03.description: Three or more new payees added in 24 hours
VEL-03.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-03 | weight=15
WHEN  beneficiary.added
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(beneficiary.added WHERE is_new = true) >= 3
THEN  signal=VEL-03

VEL-04.name: Splitting to stay under limits
VEL-04.description: Three or more transfers in 24 hours, each just under a known limit (between 90% and 99.9% of it): the ₦20,000 cap, the cash ceiling or the ATM limits
VEL-04.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-04 | weight=25
WHEN  txn.created
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount BETWEEN 0.90*L AND 0.999*L) >= 3
      WHERE L IN ( tenant.cfg.new_device_cap , cash_ceiling , atm_daily_limit , atm_weekly_limit )
THEN  signal=VEL-04  evidence=(limit_hit, amounts)   # structuring

VEL-05.name: Repeated round amounts
VEL-05.description: Three or more identical round amounts to different people in 24 hours
VEL-05.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-05 | weight=10
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount % 1_000 = 0 AND txn.amount = same AND DISTINCT beneficiary.id) >= 3
THEN  signal=VEL-05

VEL-06.name: Late-night first payment
VEL-06.description: A first large payment to a new payee between midnight and 5 a.m. Nigerian time
VEL-06.engineering_logic:
RULE VEL-06 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    beneficiary.is_new = true
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.high_value
AND   local_time(txn.ts, Africa/Lagos) BETWEEN 00:00 AND 05:00
AND   COUNT(txn WHERE beneficiary = same OVER ALL) = 0     # first payment
THEN  signal=VEL-06
